t: MISCO announced the publication of The MISCO Salaries and Benefits Report 2019-20
html:
MISCO announced the publication of The MISCO Salaries and Benefits Report 2019-20.

This report, which has been published annually for the last 34 years, is the most sought after tool of its kind due to the comprehensive and well-researched data on the trends of salaries and remuneration packages available in Malta. This report is an essential tool as it provides a realistic and up-to-date picture of what companies are paying locally.

The categories of employees covered include management, executive, clerical, technical and non-manual personnel employed in various sectors of the local market. This segmentation of information gives employers a better idea of the remuneration packages offered locally, thus permitting a more accurate positioning of your organisation within the local market.
